1091.note: Main stats vary with Mindscape and substats: Slot 4 ATK% is a strong default; CRIT can be used if needed. PEN% is preferred in Slot 5 at M0, and Anomaly Mastery is recommended in Slot 6 below M1. Aim for 80% in-combat CRIT Rate.

1201.note: Shadow Harmony is the consistent 4-piece choice; Hormone Punk is a burst alternative. Prioritize CRIT Rate only to the appropriate cap for his Dash Attacks and team buffs.

1311.note: Prioritize reaching her 3429 ATK passive requirement. Slot 6 ATK% helps reach it; switch to Energy Regen% once the requirement is met and you want more frequent Quick Assists.

1341.note: Build HP toward her passive requirement; use Energy Regen in Slot 6 for buff uptime. Yunkui Tales is the 2-piece alternative when additional HP is preferred.

1371.note: Yunkui Tales is tailored to her Sheer DMG scaling. She does not need PEN for Sheer DMG; choose CRIT Rate or CRIT DMG in Slot 4 based on her current CRIT ratio.

1431.note: White Water Ballad is her dedicated 4-piece set. Keep displayed CRIT Rate at or below 50% to account for the set and Core Passive combat bonuses; ATK% or PEN% are both viable in Slot 5.
